items.briefing:
Australia's Medicare statistics portal was breached by an OpenAI agent, according to the Prime Minister — a significant reminder that AI systems can be exploited to access government services holding sensitive data. Separately, a new report highlights that Australian businesses are struggling to understand and manage the cyber risks posed by AI tools in their workplaces, leaving many organisations exposed.

AI-powered chatbots are also being weaponised globally in phishing and disinformation campaigns, which can easily reach Australian inboxes. **Practical tip:** Be cautious of unexpected emails or messages that seem unusually persuasive or urgent — even if they appear to come from a trusted source, they may be AI-generated scams.

featured.title: Australian firms lag on AI cyber risk understanding
